questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen the film before.
Select the option that correctly reports the following statement: The man said, 'I am going to the cinema tonight.'
options: The man said he was going to the cinema that night.
The man said he is going to the cinema that night.
The man said he would go to the cinema that night.
The man said he goes to the cinema that night.
questions.answer: The man said he was going to the cinema that night.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice to report the information? The company announced that it (expand) ________ its operations into Asia.
options: The company announced that it expands its operations into Asia.
The company announced that it was expanding its operations into Asia.
The company announced that it would expand its operations into Asia.
The company announced that it has expanded its operations into Asia.
questions.answer: The company announced that it would expand its operations into Asia.

questions.question: Identify the correct reported speech form: He promised that he (help) ________ me with my homework later.
Choose the appropriate collocation: They decided to ________ the meeting until next week.
Select the correct form to complete the sentence: If I ________ you, I would take that job.
Which option correctly uses the third conditional structure? Choose the sentence that refers to a past hypothetical situation that did not happen.
options: If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I study harder, I will pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
